symbols.docstringSummary: Increments the global frame counter, checks pause triggers in active states, and dispatches the top-level game state.
Switches to UNROM bank 3, invokes routine 0xB999, and restores bank 6.
Cycles the attract-mode demo sequence index, enables demo mode, enters the transition screen, and advances to the next game mode.
Disables rendering, loads screen layout 0x82 via the bank loader, re-enables display, and invokes the overlay UI setup.
Updates the title screen cursor sprite position from option 0x1E, ticks the state timer, and advances game mode if X is zero.
Ticks attract-mode demo state and resets game mode to 0 if the title exit flag is set.
Transitions the game state machine back to top-level mode 0 by calling 0xC43D.
Handles game-over music trigger, death timer countdown, and transition to continue or reset state.
Dispatches the current game submode in 0x11 through the inline jump table at 0xC1D6.
Initializes either a new game or a continued game based on menu selection 0x1E and resets the cutscene step.
Initializes continued game state via 0xD758 and resets the cutscene step counter.
Updates the room background music via 0xC546 and advances to the next top-level game mode.
Polls pause toggle and, while unpaused, counts down the demo state timer to update music and runs the active frame handler.
Dispatches the current game submode in 0x11 through the inline jump table at 0xC20D.
Streams the screen layout at 0xD3CF, clears the CHR stream page index, and advances the game submode.
Clears PPU mask shadow via 0xC49B and either loads a CHR page and advances submode or loads room 0xF5 layout.
Queues the room CHR stream and stream 6, clears the entity buffer, advances submode, and queues alert overlay streams.
Plays menu confirm or select sound effects via audio trigger when A or Select buttons are newly pressed.
Queues two XOR-selected PPU tile streams driven by alert channel flags at 0x98.
Queues PPU tile stream 0x14, invokes bank 5 and bank 3 screen setup routines, restores bank 6, and advances game submode.
Checks if the A button was newly pressed on joypad 1 and resets the main game state to mode 0.
Dispatches the current game submode in 0x11 through the inline jump table at 0xC2BD.
Switches to bank 4 to run screen state update, then queues stream 9, initializes PPU/HUD state, and sets game mode 4 when submode hits 0.
Disables rendering, uploads room 0xF0 layout and bank 0 screen data, sets palette/stream 0x12, and clears the entity buffer.
Initializes room boss state, collectible/objective objects, scripted room spawns, and room hazard actors.
Dispatches the current game submode in 0x11 through the inline jump table at 0xC348.
Resets player/world timers on full transition or updates boss, hazard, objective, and pickup spawns on partial room transitions.
Restores active gameplay mode 5, clears temporary weapon and room reload flags, resumes room music, and triggers bank 0 alert setup if activ
Sets the low state timer byte in 0x2A and increments the game submode counter by one.
Increments the global game submode counter in 0x11 by one.
Advances to the next top-level game mode, sets the state timer to 0x80, and clears the title exit flag and submode.
Advances to the next top-level game mode and resets the title exit flag and submode counter.
Transitions to the specified top-level game mode with a 0x50-frame timer, resets submode and title exit flags, and returns zero.
Decrements the 16-bit state countdown timer in 0x2A-0x2B and returns nonzero while active or on low-byte wrap.
Resets the cutscene step counter in 0x07CE to zero and advances the game submode.
Dispatches the active cutscene step in 0x07CE via inline jump table, or advances submode when the step wraps from 0xFF.
Disables rendering via PPU mask shadow, resets CHR stream page index, queues the room CHR stream, and advances cutscene step.
Disables rendering via 0xC49B and either sets the CHR page and advances cutscene step or loads the room nametable layout.
Clears the PPU mask shadow register in 0xFE to blank rendering on the next NMI.
Clears PPU mask shadow via 0xC49B and either sets CHR page and increments cutscene step or loads room-specific bank graphics.
Disables rendering via 0xC49B and either records the CHR page and advances cutscene step or uploads the room tileset chunked.
Disables rendering, resets vertical PPU scroll to 0xF8, decompresses the current room layout, restores bank 6, and advances cutscene step.
Disables rendering via PPU mask shadow, triggers the cutscene palette/fade step from 0x07CE - 5, and increments cutscene step.
Blanks the PPU mask shadow, uploads the RAM 0x0700 attribute row via 0xC653, and advances the cutscene step.
Queues tile stream 5, resets actor and room tables via bank 4 on normal transitions, clears alert sound, enables display, and ends cutscene.
Selects and triggers room, alert, or transition background music based on transition state, demo flags, and active alert status.
Selects default area BGM track 0x69 or 0x45 from room metadata flags and triggers playback when the track changes.
Updates the requested BGM track shadow in 0xEF and triggers audio playback when the track changes and demo rules permit.
Decodes a metasprite descriptor from zero-page 0x88 into OAM shadow sprite entries using single-sprite or 2-column layout rules.
Renders a multi-tile metasprite sequence into the 0x0200 OAM shadow buffer and updates the OAM write cursor in 0x84.
Computes palette and flip attributes from metasprite data at 0x88 and writes the attribute byte to the OAM shadow buffer.
Populates a rectangular grid of OAM shadow sprite entries from a metasprite descriptor pointer and advances the OAM write cursor.
Finalizes a single OAM sprite entry's attributes via 0xCB33, advances the OAM cursor by four bytes, and returns 0x8E.
Iterates over 32 sprite slots in 0x0300-0x0360 and populates the OAM shadow buffer.
Stores two byte arguments into zero-page scratch locations 0x8E and 0x8B and returns the first value.
Selects a PPU tile stream offset based on room bank flags and queues the room's CHR or palette transfer.
Loads the current room's bank and data pointer, uploads a chunked nametable slice, and restores PRG bank 6.
Loads the current room's bank and data pointer, immediately streams the nametable data to PPU_DATA, and restores PRG bank 6.
Switches to the PRG bank for the current room and loads its room data pointer into zero-page 0x80.
Selects UNROM bank 0 to upload a chunked nametable slice for special rooms, or marks 0x07CF as 0xFF for standard rooms.
Selects the room tileset bank and pointer, uploads a chunked nametable slice to PPU_DATA, and restores bank 6.
Selects the room tileset bank and pointer, streams all tileset bytes immediately to PPU_DATA, and restores bank 6.
Switches to the tileset PRG bank for the current room and returns the doubled tileset table offset.
Loads a 16-bit pointer from the active bank's 0x8001 pointer table into zero-page 0x80.
Silences audio channels, clears the 0x0300 entity buffer, initializes gameplay PPU/HUD streams, and invokes bank 1 initialization.
Streams the built-in compressed PPU tile layout at 0xD444+0x32 to PPU_DATA and re-enables NMI.
Disables rendering, resets scroll and queue cursor, streams the compressed PPU layout at 0xD444+8, and re-enables NMI.
Disables rendering, resets scroll, streams the compressed PPU nametable layout at 0xD444[layout_offset], and re-enables NMI.
Switches to UNROM bank 3 to run sprite updates and restores the previous PRG bank.
Copies a PPU tile update stream from the bank-0 table into the 0x0740 NMI transfer queue.
Appends a single byte to the 0x0740 NMI VRAM transfer queue and increments the queue cursor.
Writes a byte to a specific index in the 0x0740 VRAM transfer queue and sets the cursor to the following slot.
Disables rendering, streams nametable/attribute bytes from zero-page 0x80 to PPU_DATA until zero terminator, and re-enables NMI.
Disables rendering, streams inline PPU address and data bytes from after the return address to PPU_DATA until zero terminator, and re-enable
Forwards directly to the inline PPU data stream uploader at 0xD545.
Disables rendering and uploads a 96-byte nametable slice to PPU_DATA while preserving multi-frame cursor state.
Uploads a null-terminated PPU text or attribute block indexed by entry_index from table 0xC5FF, or runs default layout 0xD3C0.
Uploads null-terminated attribute data from RAM 0x0700 to PPU nametable attribute memory at 0x23C0 and re-enables NMI.
Zeroes the 128-byte entity state buffer at RAM 0x0300-0x037F.
Zeroes 66 bytes of zero-page actor and alert state starting at address 0x0098.
Performs a 16-step shift-and-add multiplication storing the result across zero-page 0x80-0x82.
Reads a 16-bit target address from the inline pointer table after the JSR return address and jumps to it.
Adds an 8-bit unsigned value to a 16-bit little-endian integer in zero page with carry propagation.
Subtracts an 8-bit unsigned value from a 16-bit little-endian integer in zero page with borrow propagation.
Zeroes the 128-byte sprite and actor attribute buffer at 0x0300-0x037F using zero-page pointer 0x80.
Selects UNROM PRG bank 0 via bus-conflict-safe write to ROM address 0xFFD0.
Selects UNROM PRG bank 1 via bus-conflict-safe write to ROM address 0xFFD1.
Selects UNROM PRG bank 2 via bus-conflict-safe write to ROM address 0xFFD2.
Selects UNROM PRG bank 3 via bus-conflict-safe write to ROM address 0xFFD3.
Selects UNROM PRG bank 4 via bus-conflict-safe write to ROM address 0xFFD4.
Selects UNROM PRG bank 5 via bus-conflict-safe write to ROM address 0xFFD5.
Selects UNROM PRG bank 6 (audio and shared tables) via bus-conflict-safe write to ROM address 0xFFD6.
Selects an UNROM PRG bank by index and resets the tracked active bank shadow.
Restores the UNROM PRG bank stored in zero-page 0x27.
Switches to UNROM bank 6 and invokes the audio trigger routine for the requested sound ID.
Clean-room D3 bank/signature adapter for 0x0000f5ac.
Clean-room D3 bank/signature adapter for 0x0000fbf5.
Clean-room D3 bank/signature adapter for 0x0000ee2a.
Clean-room D3 bank/signature adapter for 0x000099a8.
Clean-room D3 bank/signature adapter for 0x0000a765.
Clean-room D3 bank/signature adapter for 0x0000bb28.
Clean-room D3 bank/signature adapter for 0x0000b83a.
Clean-room D3 bank/signature adapter for 0x0000bbe1.
Hardware reset vector that waits for PPU warmup, clears RAM, initializes PPU/APU, switches to bank 6, and starts audio.
NMI interrupt handler that runs OAM DMA, updates PPU mask and scroll, polls joypads, ticks audio, and dispatches the main state.
Empty IRQ vector stub that returns immediately.
Initializes APU channels, disables frame IRQ, enables NMI in PPU_CTRL, and sets the 5-frame blanking delay.
Enables NMI and pattern table bits in PPU_CTRL and sets the 5-frame display delay counter.
Resets PPU address latch to nametable 0, writes shadow scroll coordinates to PPU_SCROLL, and restores PPU_CTRL.
Zeroes PPU_ADDR, PPU_MASK, and PPU_CTRL to safely disable rendering and NMI.
Clears gameplay zero-page and RAM buffers and enables NMI via 0xFCC9.
Clears RAM via 0xFCC9, disables demo mode, and loads the selected title option mode into 0x19.
Disables rendering, zeroes zero-page 0x22-0xEF and RAM pages 0x0300-0x06FF, and re-enables PPU NMI.
Polls both NES joypads, masks held inputs, and records newly pressed button edges in 0xF5 and 0xF6.
Polls both NES joypads and stores raw held button bitmasks in 0x15 and 0x16.
Strobes hardware joypad ports 0x4016/0x4017 and shifts 8 bits per controller into zero-page 0x84 and 0x85.
Checks Start/Select edge bits in 0xF5 to toggle pause/transceiver mode or play pause sound effect.
Sets the 16-bit state timer in 0x2A-0x2B to 0x0100 (256 frames).
